SELECT 'sum' t, metric, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, round(avg(value),3) av FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'profile%' OR attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'frontend%' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'trace', span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,3) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='profile' OR attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'profile%' GROUP BY ALL
